perf.summary: Same redundant Size(Left)/Sum(Left), Size(Right)/Sum(Right) double-load-and-null-check pattern.
perf.currentCost: 4 child loads + 4 null compares per Update, every Split/Merge frame in Reverse.
perf.proposedChange: Cache child pointers once: `TreapRevNode* l = n->Left, r = n->Right;` then fused size+sum per child.
perf.rationale: Halves loads/branches and exploits Size/Sum cache-line locality.
